tools.name: get_league_standings
tools.description: Retrieve current football league standings table (rank, team, played, W/D/L, goal difference, points). Default league_id=39 (Premier League).

tools.name: get_public_performance_kpi
tools.description: Retrieve XG Mind's public cumulative verification KPIs and available settlement months across 30+ competitions.

tools.name: get_recent_settled_ledger
tools.description: Retrieve recently settled public match verification records (scores, outcome hit flags, and canonical report links).

tools.name: list_research_articles
tools.description: List empirical quantitative football research articles published on the XG Mind blog (titles, summaries, URLs).

tools.name: get_upcoming_public_matches
tools.description: List recent and upcoming public match schedules (matchups, competition, kickoff UTC, status, and public briefing URLs).
